intent: Enrich candidates (timing, tier, access, exclusions, date sensitivity), build dim_labs, fct_release_candidates, time spine, cadence and significance reports, and pin METHODOLOGY numbers in tests

edits.new_content:
{#- Every enrichment here is derived from the research CSV itself, the mapping seeds,
    or METHODOLOGY.md; nothing comes from new research. -#}

with

candidates as (

    select * from {{ ref('stg_research__release_candidates') }}

),

release_types as (

    select * from {{ ref('seed_release_type_map') }}

),

tiers as (

    select * from {{ ref('seed_tier_map') }}

),

labs as (

    select * from {{ ref('seed_labs') }}

),

source_domains as (

    select * from {{ ref('seed_source_domains') }}

),

date_sensitivity as (

    select * from {{ ref('seed_date_sensitivity') }}

),

joined as (

    select
        candidates.*,
        release_types.access_level,
        release_types.open_weights_status,
        release_types.has_gated_variant,
        release_types.is_snapshot_update,
        release_types.is_staggered_rollout,
        coalesce(tiers.tier_band, 'not_classified') as tier_band,
        tiers.tier_rank,
        not labs.in_scope_list as is_borderline_lab,
        source_domains.source_type,
        source_domains.source_rank,
        date_sensitivity.conflicting_date

    from candidates
    left join release_types
        on candidates.release_type = release_types.release_type
    left join tiers
        on candidates.tier = tiers.tier
    left join labs
        on candidates.lab_id = labs.lab_id
    left join source_domains
        on candidates.source_domain = source_domains.source_domain
    left join date_sensitivity
        on candidates.model_name = date_sensitivity.model_name

),

timed as (

    select
        *,
        release_date - date '{{ var("essay_date") }}' as days_from_essay,
        coalesce(conflicting_date, release_date) as alt_release_date,
        coalesce(conflicting_date, release_date) - date '{{ var("essay_date") }}' as days_from_essay_alt_date

    from joined

),

classified as (

    select
        *,
        {{ essay_window('days_from_essay') }} as essay_window,
        {{ essay_window('days_from_essay_alt_date') }} as essay_window_alt_date,
        -- Signed 7-day buckets: days 1..7 are week +1, days -1..-7 are week -1. Weeks +5 and -5
        -- hold only days 29..30 (and -29..-30) of a window, plus any outside rows.
        cast(sign(days_from_essay) * ceil(abs(days_from_essay) / 7.0) as integer) as week_from_essay,
        dayname(release_date) as release_weekday,
        isodow(release_date) in (6, 7) as is_weekend,
        conflicting_date is not null as has_date_conflict,
        access_level = 'general_availability' as is_generally_available,
        access_level in ('preview_or_limited', 'gated_or_restricted', 'announced_only') as is_restricted_access,
        access_level = 'announced_only' as is_announced_only,
        open_weights_status in ('at_launch', 'promised_later') as is_open_weights,
        case
            when is_top_tier and is_snapshot_update then 'flagship_refresh'
            when is_top_tier then 'new_flagship'
            when not is_top_tier then 'below_flagship'
            else 'not_assessed'
        end as top_tier_kind,
        case
            when is_counted then null
            when notes ilike '%outside the 13-lab list%' then 'lab_outside_list'
            when {{ essay_window('days_from_essay') }} = 'outside' then 'outside_window'
            when notes ilike '%earnings call%' then 'roadmap_mention'
            when notes ilike '%never announced%' or access_level = 'cancelled' then 'never_released'
            when notes ilike '%decision-only%' then 'decision_only_endpoint'
            when notes ilike '%configuration%' then 'product_configuration'
            when notes ilike '%serving%' or notes ilike '%pricing%' then 'serving_or_pricing_tier'
            when regexp_matches(lower(notes), 'image|video|speech|voice|avatar|translation') then 'non_llm_modality'
            else 'unclassified'
        end as exclusion_category,
        case
            when notes ilike '%DevDay%' then 'OpenAI DevDay'
            when notes ilike '%Apsara%' then 'Alibaba Apsara Conference'
        end as launch_event

    from timed

),

final as (

    select
        *,
        essay_window is distinct from essay_window_alt_date as is_window_date_sensitive,
        -- METHODOLOGY 7.2 variants of the counting rule.
        is_counted and not is_announced_only as is_counted_released_only,
        is_counted or (is_borderline_lab and essay_window in ('before', 'after')) as is_counted_incl_borderline

    from classified

)

select * from final

version: 2

models:
  - name: int_release_candidates__enriched
    description: >
      Staged candidates joined to the mapping seeds, with every derived field the analysis
      uses: timing relative to the essay, normalized tier and access, exclusion category,
      the date-sensitivity windows and the METHODOLOGY 7.2 counting variants.
    columns:
      - name: release_id
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: essay_window
        description: Window re-derived from release_date with the essay_window macro.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [before, after, essay_day, outside]
      - name: access_level
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: source_type
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: is_borderline_lab
        data_tests: [not_null]

with

labs as (

    select * from {{ ref('seed_labs') }}

),

final as (

    select
        lab_id,
        lab_name,
        in_scope_list,
        case when in_scope_list then 'agreed_13_lab_list' else 'borderline' end as lab_scope,
        parent_country,
        region,
        essay_coordination_group,
        essay_stance,
        essay_stance in ('author', 'endorsed_publicly') as is_author_or_endorser,
        stance_date,
        stance_quote,
        stance_source_url

    from labs

)

select * from final

{#- One row per candidate release, counted or not, so that exclusions and every
    sensitivity variant stay queryable. Filter on is_counted for the main definition. -#}

with

enriched as (

    select * from {{ ref('int_release_candidates__enriched') }}

),

final as (

    select
        -- keys
        release_id,
        lab_id,

        -- what was released
        model_name,
        developer_name,
        tier,
        tier_band,
        tier_rank,
        is_top_tier,
        top_tier_kind,
        release_type,
        access_level,
        is_generally_available,
        is_restricted_access,
        is_announced_only,
        has_gated_variant,
        open_weights_status,
        is_open_weights,
        is_snapshot_update,
        is_staggered_rollout,
        launch_event,

        -- when, relative to the essay
        release_date,
        days_from_essay,
        essay_window,
        week_from_essay,
        release_weekday,
        is_weekend,

        -- counting rule and its variants
        is_counted,
        exclusion_category,
        is_borderline_lab,
        is_counted_released_only,
        is_counted_incl_borderline,

        -- date sensitivity (METHODOLOGY 7.1)
        has_date_conflict,
        alt_release_date,
        days_from_essay_alt_date,
        essay_window_alt_date,
        is_window_date_sensitive,

        -- evidence
        source_url,
        source_domain,
        source_type,
        source_rank,
        notes

    from enriched

)

select * from final

{#- Cadence: one row per pair of consecutive days on which at least one counted model
    was released. A pause after the essay would show up as a long across_essay gap. -#}

with

release_days as (

    select
        release_date,
        count(*) as releases_on_day

    from {{ ref('fct_release_candidates') }}
    where is_counted
    group by release_date

),

paired as (

    select
        lag(release_date) over (order by release_date) as gap_start_date,
        release_date as gap_end_date,
        releases_on_day as releases_on_end_date

    from release_days

),

final as (

    select
        strftime(gap_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') || '_' || strftime(gap_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as gap_id,
        gap_start_date,
        gap_end_date,
        gap_end_date - gap_start_date as gap_days,
        gap_end_date - gap_start_date - 1 as quiet_days,
        releases_on_end_date,
        {{ essay_window("gap_start_date - date '" ~ var('essay_date') ~ "'") }} as start_window,
        {{ essay_window("gap_end_date - date '" ~ var('essay_date') ~ "'") }} as end_window,
        case
            when gap_start_date < date '{{ var("essay_date") }}'
                and gap_end_date > date '{{ var("essay_date") }}' then 'across_essay'
            when gap_end_date < date '{{ var("essay_date") }}' then 'within_before'
            else 'within_after'
        end as gap_position

    from paired
    where gap_start_date is not null

)

select * from final

{#- Before vs after, segment by segment, with an exact two-sided test of "same release rate
    in both windows". Under that null, and given n = before + after releases, the after count
    is Binomial(n, 0.5) (the conditional test for two Poisson counts over equal exposure).
    The two-sided p-value doubles the smaller tail, capped at 1. With this many segments,
    read the Bonferroni column before calling anything a signal. -#}

with

candidates as (

    select
        releases.*,
        labs.region,
        labs.is_author_or_endorser

    from {{ ref('fct_release_candidates') }} as releases
    left join {{ ref('dim_labs') }} as labs
        on releases.lab_id = labs.lab_id

),

comparisons as (

    select * from (values
        (1, 'all_counted', 'headline', 'All counted releases (main definition)'),
        (2, 'top_tier', 'capability', 'Top-tier releases'),
        (3, 'new_flagship', 'capability', 'New flagships (top tier, excluding snapshot refreshes)'),
        (4, 'below_flagship', 'capability', 'Releases below the top tier'),
        (5, 'author_or_endorser', 'essay_stance', 'Labs that wrote or publicly endorsed the essay'),
        (6, 'no_response_recorded', 'essay_stance', 'Labs with no recorded response'),
        (7, 'region_us', 'geography', 'US labs'),
        (8, 'region_china', 'geography', 'Chinese labs'),
        (9, 'region_europe', 'geography', 'European labs'),
        (10, 'generally_available', 'access', 'Generally available at announcement'),
        (11, 'restricted_access', 'access', 'Preview, limited, gated or announced only'),
        (12, 'open_weights', 'access', 'Open weights at launch or promised'),
        (13, 'top_tier_generally_available', 'access', 'Top-tier and generally available'),
        (14, 'top_tier_restricted', 'access', 'Top-tier with restricted access'),
        (15, 'released_only', 'sensitivity', 'Excluding announced-only models'),
        (16, 'incl_borderline_labs', 'sensitivity', 'Including the four borderline labs'),
        (17, 'worst_case_dates', 'sensitivity', 'Date-sensitive rows moved to their conflicting dates')
    ) as t (comparison_order, comparison_id, comparison_group, comparison_label)

),

memberships as (

    select
        comparisons.comparison_id,
        case comparisons.comparison_id
            when 'all_counted' then candidates.is_counted
            when 'top_tier' then candidates.is_counted and candidates.is_top_tier
            when 'new_flagship' then candidates.is_counted and candidates.top_tier_kind = 'new_flagship'
            when 'below_flagship' then candidates.is_counted and not candidates.is_top_tier
            when 'author_or_endorser' then candidates.is_counted and candidates.is_author_or_endorser
            when 'no_response_recorded' then candidates.is_counted and not candidates.is_author_or_endorser
            when 'region_us' then candidates.is_counted and candidates.region = 'US'
            when 'region_china' then candidates.is_counted and candidates.region = 'China'
            when 'region_europe' then candidates.is_counted and candidates.region = 'Europe'
            when 'generally_available' then candidates.is_counted and candidates.is_generally_available
            when 'restricted_access' then candidates.is_counted and candidates.is_restricted_access
            when 'open_weights' then candidates.is_counted and candidates.is_open_weights
            when 'top_tier_generally_available' then candidates.is_counted and candidates.is_top_tier and candidates.is_generally_available
            when 'top_tier_restricted' then candidates.is_counted and candidates.is_top_tier and candidates.is_restricted_access
            when 'released_only' then candidates.is_counted_released_only
            when 'incl_borderline_labs' then candidates.is_counted_incl_borderline
            when 'worst_case_dates' then candidates.is_counted
        end as is_member,
        case
            when comparisons.comparison_id = 'worst_case_dates' then candidates.essay_window_alt_date
            else candidates.essay_window
        end as comparison_window

    from candidates
    cross join comparisons

),

counts as (

    select
        comparison_id,
        count(*) filter (where is_member and comparison_window = 'before') as before_count,
        count(*) filter (where is_member and comparison_window = 'after') as after_count

    from memberships
    group by comparison_id

),

outcomes as (

    select
        comparison_id,
        after_count,
        cast(before_count + after_count as double) as n,
        unnest(range(0, before_count + after_count + 1)) as k

    from counts

),

probabilities as (

    select
        comparison_id,
        after_count,
        k,
        exp(lgamma(n + 1) - lgamma(k + 1) - lgamma(n - k + 1) - n * ln(2)) as probability

    from outcomes

),

tails as (

    select
        comparison_id,
        sum(probability) filter (where k <= after_count) as lower_tail,
        sum(probability) filter (where k >= after_count) as upper_tail

    from probabilities
    group by comparison_id

),

final as (

    select
        comparisons.comparison_order,
        comparisons.comparison_id,
        comparisons.comparison_group,
        comparisons.comparison_label,
        counts.before_count,
        counts.after_count,
        counts.after_count - counts.before_count as change,
        case
            when counts.before_count > 0
                then round(counts.after_count::double / counts.before_count, 3)
        end as rate_ratio,
        least(1.0, 2 * least(tails.lower_tail, tails.upper_tail)) as p_value_two_sided,
        least(1.0, 2 * least(tails.lower_tail, tails.upper_tail) * count(*) over ()) as p_value_bonferroni

    from comparisons
    inner join counts
        on comparisons.comparison_id = counts.comparison_id
    inner join tails
        on comparisons.comparison_id = tails.comparison_id

)

select * from final
order by comparison_order

version: 2

models:
  - name: dim_labs
    description: >
      One row per lab in the research (13 on the agreed list, 4 borderline), with its
      geography and its recorded public stance on the essay. See seed_labs for sourcing.
    columns:
      - name: lab_id
        description: Lab key (slug of the lab name).
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: lab_name
        description: Lab name as written in the research.
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: in_scope_list
        description: True for the 13 labs on the agreed list.
      - name: lab_scope
        description: agreed_13_lab_list or borderline.
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [agreed_13_lab_list, borderline]
      - name: parent_country
        description: Country of the parent company.
      - name: region
        description: US, China, Europe or Japan.
      - name: essay_coordination_group
        description: us_frontier_company, other_democracy or china (see seed_labs).
      - name: essay_stance
        description: author, endorsed_publicly or none_recorded.
      - name: is_author_or_endorser
        description: True for Anthropic (author), OpenAI and xAI (public endorsements on 12 Sep 2026).
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: stance_date
        description: Date of the recorded public stance.
      - name: stance_quote
        description: Verbatim public statement.
      - name: stance_source_url
        description: Source of the stance.

  - name: fct_release_candidates
    description: >
      One row per candidate release (52), counted or not. The main definition is
      `is_counted`; `is_counted_released_only`, `is_counted_incl_borderline` and
      `essay_window_alt_date` reproduce the METHODOLOGY 7.2 variants.
    columns:
      - name: release_id
        description: Surrogate key, slugify(developer) || '__' || slugify(model).
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: lab_id
        description: Lab key.
        data_tests:
          - not_null
          - relationships:
              arguments:
                to: ref('dim_labs')
                field: lab_id
      - name: model_name
        description: Model name as written in the research; combined names are one counted unit.
      - name: developer_name
        description: Lab name as written in the research.
      - name: tier
        description: Position in the developer's lineup as written in the research.
      - name: tier_band
        description: flagship, upper, mid, small_fast or not_classified (no tier recorded).
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [flagship, upper, mid, small_fast, not_classified]
      - name: tier_rank
        description: 1 flagship, 2 upper, 3 mid, 4 small or fast.
      - name: is_top_tier
        description: The researcher's top_tier flag (METHODOLOGY 4.6). Null on excluded rows.
      - name: top_tier_kind
        description: >
          new_flagship (top tier, not a snapshot), flagship_refresh (top tier and a point or
          snapshot update of an existing flagship), below_flagship, or not_assessed (excluded rows).
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [new_flagship, flagship_refresh, below_flagship, not_assessed]
      - name: release_type
        description: Release type as written in the research.
      - name: access_level
        description: Normalized access on the counted date (see seed_release_type_map).
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [general_availability, preview_or_limited, gated_or_restricted, announced_only, cancelled, non_release]
      - name: is_generally_available
        description: access_level = general_availability.
      - name: is_restricted_access
        description: Preview or limited, gated or restricted, or announced only.
      - name: is_announced_only
        description: Announced, not released (Qwen4).
      - name: has_gated_variant
        description: The same model also shipped at a restricted access level.
      - name: open_weights_status
        description: at_launch, promised_later or none.
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [at_launch, promised_later, none]
      - name: is_open_weights
        description: Weights released at launch or promised for later.
      - name: is_snapshot_update
        description: Point release or snapshot update of an existing model.
      - name: is_staggered_rollout
        description: Wider access or weights announced for later dates.
      - name: launch_event
        description: Event the release was tied to, when the research notes name one.
      - name: release_date
        description: Announcement date (METHODOLOGY 4.5).
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: days_from_essay
        description: release_date minus the essay date (12 Sep 2026), in days.
      - name: essay_window
        description: before (-30..-1), after (+1..+30), essay_day (0) or outside.
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [before, after, essay_day, outside]
      - name: week_from_essay
        description: Signed 7-day bucket of days_from_essay (+1 = days 1..7, -1 = days -1..-7).
      - name: release_weekday
        description: Day of the week of release_date.
      - name: is_weekend
        description: Released on a Saturday or Sunday.
      - name: is_counted
        description: Meets the inclusion rules (METHODOLOGY 4.2). The main definition.
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: exclusion_category
        description: For excluded rows, the METHODOLOGY 4.3 category; null for counted rows.
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [lab_outside_list, outside_window, roadmap_mention, never_released, decision_only_endpoint, product_configuration, serving_or_pricing_tier, non_llm_modality]
      - name: is_borderline_lab
        description: Developer is one of the four borderline labs.
      - name: is_counted_released_only
        description: Main definition minus announced-only models (METHODOLOGY 7.2).
      - name: is_counted_incl_borderline
        description: Main definition plus the borderline labs' in-window releases (METHODOLOGY 7.2).
      - name: has_date_conflict
        description: Credible sources disagree on the date (METHODOLOGY 7.1).
      - name: alt_release_date
        description: The conflicting date where one exists, otherwise release_date.
      - name: days_from_essay_alt_date
        description: alt_release_date minus the essay date.
      - name: essay_window_alt_date
        description: Window under the conflicting dates (the METHODOLOGY 7.1 worst case).
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [before, after, essay_day, outside]
      - name: is_window_date_sensitive
        description: The conflicting date would move the row to a different window.
      - name: source_url
        description: Main supporting source.
      - name: source_domain
        description: Host of source_url.
      - name: source_type
        description: vendor, tracker, press or aggregator (METHODOLOGY 5).
      - name: source_rank
        description: 1 vendor, 2 tracker, 3 press, 4 aggregator.
      - name: notes
        description: Research notes as written.

  - name: metricflow_time_spine
    description: Day-grain calendar for 2026, required by MetricFlow.
    time_spine:
      standard_granularity_column: date_day
    columns:
      - name: date_day
        granularity: day
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]

  - name: rpt_release_gaps
    description: >
      One row per pair of consecutive days with at least one counted release. gap_position
      says whether the gap sits inside a window or spans the essay date.
    columns:
      - name: gap_id
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: gap_start_date
        description: Previous day with a counted release.
      - name: gap_end_date
        description: Day with a counted release.
      - name: gap_days
        description: Days between the two release days.
      - name: quiet_days
        description: Days with no counted release in between (gap_days - 1).
      - name: releases_on_end_date
        description: Counted releases on gap_end_date.
      - name: start_window
        description: Window of gap_start_date.
      - name: end_window
        description: Window of gap_end_date.
      - name: gap_position
        description: within_before, within_after or across_essay.
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [within_before, within_after, across_essay]

  - name: rpt_rate_tests
    description: >
      Before vs after counts per segment, with an exact conditional binomial test of equal
      release rates and a Bonferroni correction across all rows. Descriptive statistics on
      small counts, not evidence of cause.
    columns:
      - name: comparison_id
        data_tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: comparison_order
        description: Display order.
      - name: comparison_group
        description: headline, capability, essay_stance, geography, access or sensitivity.
      - name: comparison_label
        description: What the segment counts.
      - name: before_count
        description: Releases in the 30 days before the essay.
      - name: after_count
        description: Releases in the 30 days after the essay.
      - name: change
        description: after_count - before_count.
      - name: rate_ratio
        description: after_count / before_count; null when before_count is 0.
      - name: p_value_two_sided
        description: Exact two-sided p-value of Binomial(before + after, 0.5) at after_count.
      - name: p_value_bonferroni
        description: p_value_two_sided times the number of comparisons, capped at 1.

-- The window re-derived from the date must equal the window the researcher recorded
-- (the assertion in METHODOLOGY section 6).
select
    release_id,
    release_date,
    source_essay_window,
    essay_window
from {{ ref('int_release_candidates__enriched') }}
where essay_window is distinct from source_essay_window

-- Every count published in METHODOLOGY sections 2 and 7.2 must be reproduced by the marts.
with

expected as (

    select * from (values
        ('counted', 'before', 15),
        ('counted', 'after', 14),
        ('top_tier', 'before', 7),
        ('top_tier', 'after', 5),
        ('labs_shipping', 'before', 9),
        ('labs_shipping', 'after', 8),
        ('released_only', 'before', 15),
        ('released_only', 'after', 13),
        ('incl_borderline_labs', 'before', 16),
        ('incl_borderline_labs', 'after', 18),
        ('worst_case_dates', 'before', 13),
        ('worst_case_dates', 'after', 14)
    ) as t (measure, essay_window, expected_count)

),

releases as (

    select * from {{ ref('fct_release_candidates') }}

),

actual as (

    select 'counted' as measure, essay_window, count(*) as actual_count
    from releases where is_counted group by 1, 2
    union all
    select 'top_tier', essay_window, count(*)
    from releases where is_counted and is_top_tier group by 1, 2
    union all
    select 'labs_shipping', essay_window, count(distinct lab_id)
    from releases where is_counted group by 1, 2
    union all
    select 'released_only', essay_window, count(*)
    from releases where is_counted_released_only group by 1, 2
    union all
    select 'incl_borderline_labs', essay_window, count(*)
    from releases where is_counted_incl_borderline group by 1, 2
    union all
    select 'worst_case_dates', essay_window_alt_date, count(*)
    from releases where is_counted group by 1, 2

)

select
    expected.measure,
    expected.essay_window,
    expected.expected_count,
    coalesce(actual.actual_count, 0) as actual_count
from expected
left join actual
    on expected.measure = actual.measure
    and expected.essay_window = actual.essay_window
where expected.expected_count <> coalesce(actual.actual_count, 0)

        ('xAI', 0, 1),
        ('MiniMax', 0, 1),
        ('Mistral AI', 0, 1),
        ('ByteDance', 0, 0)
    ) as t (lab_name, expected_before, expected_after)

),

labs as (

    select * from {{ ref('dim_labs') }}
    where in_scope_list

),

counts as (

    select
        lab_id,
        count(*) filter (where essay_window = 'before') as actual_before,
        count(*) filter (where essay_window = 'after') as actual_after
    from {{ ref('fct_release_candidates') }}
    where is_counted
    group by lab_id

)

select
    coalesce(expected.lab_name, labs.lab_name) as lab_name,
    expected.expected_before,
    expected.expected_after,
    coalesce(counts.actual_before, 0) as actual_before,
    coalesce(counts.actual_after, 0) as actual_after
from expected
full outer join labs
    on expected.lab_name = labs.lab_name
left join counts
    on labs.lab_id = counts.lab_id
where expected.lab_name is null
    or labs.lab_id is null
    or expected.expected_before <> coalesce(counts.actual_before, 0)
    or expected.expected_after <> coalesce(counts.actual_after, 0)

from {{ ref('fct_release_candidates') }}
where (is_counted and exclusion_category is not null)
    or (not is_counted and exclusion_category is null)

-- Pins the exact test to values worked by hand, so a broken implementation cannot pass.
--   15 vs 14: the after count sits at the centre of Binomial(29, 0.5), so p = 1.
--   10 vs 3: P(X <= 3 | n = 13) = (1 + 13 + 78 + 286) / 8192 = 0.046142578125, doubled.
with

expected as (

    select * from (values
        ('all_counted', 15, 14, 1.0),
        ('region_china', 10, 3, 0.09228515625)
    ) as t (comparison_id, before_count, after_count, p_value_two_sided)

)

select
    expected.comparison_id,
    expected.p_value_two_sided as expected_p,
    tests.p_value_two_sided as actual_p
from expected
left join {{ ref('rpt_rate_tests') }} as tests
    on expected.comparison_id = tests.comparison_id
where tests.comparison_id is null
    or tests.before_count <> expected.before_count
    or tests.after_count <> expected.after_count
    or abs(tests.p_value_two_sided - expected.p_value_two_sided) > 1e-9
    or tests.p_value_two_sided not between 0 and 1
